mutation.adapter: Map PIT mutations.xml into targets[]: one target per class/source file, treat NO_COVERAGE separately from SURVIVED.

notes: Copy this file to quality-gate.config.json in the adopting repository root and keep mutation.report at artifacts/mutation-report.json.
The shipped quality-gate.yml passes this file to mutation_gate.py run --config on every pull request and trunk push; MUTATION_COMMAND is only a fallback.
Cucumber-JVM is the industry-standard BDD runner for the JVM; -Dcucumber.plugin=junit:<path> writes the acceptance artifact.
PITest is the industry-standard mutation testing system for Java and Kotlin (via the PITest Kotlin plugin).
PMD CyclomaticComplexity rules are a second complexity opinion for JVM sources.
Add services: or testcontainers when acceptance tests require real middleware.
Never mark a gate command non-blocking or ignore its exit code.
